blocking_findings: P2ADV-1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: track A tie-break in guide.ts picks the alphabetically first route on an equal worst score instead of the D13 order. Test: adversarial-p2.test.ts P2ADV-1 tie-break (spec D13). Rationale: guide.ts:241 sorts by worst score then route name, while D13 breaks a tie by the higher worst blocker recall and then the higher median score; at HEAD a-route (median 81) beats z-route (median 82) on a shared worst of 80.0.

P2ADV-2 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: the newest score file selection is the alphabetically last glob match, not the newest by date. Test: adversarial-p2.test.ts P2ADV-2 newest score file (preview.sh/update.sh header newest review score file). Rationale: preview.sh:126-130 and update.sh:61-65 keep the last glob match, so an older mg-2026-11p file wins over a newer mg-2026-11a file; at HEAD the preview picks old-model from the older pilot file.

P2ADV-3 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: update.sh after the approval exits 1 on a no-change week. Test: adversarial-p2.test.ts P2ADV-3 rerun (spec D19). Rationale: git commit with nothing to commit exits 1 under set -e, so the second identical weekly run fails; the D19 weekly update must be re-runnable.

P2ADV-4 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: guide.ts parseArgs accepts inherited Object.prototype keys as flags. Test: adversarial-p2.test.ts P2ADV-4 unknown flags (guide.ts header: a flag is unknown). Rationale: FLAGS[argv[i]] reads the prototype chain, so __proto__, constructor, and toString with a value are accepted with exit 0 instead of refused with input-check: args.

P2ADV-5 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: update.sh follows a symlinked docs/assets/data outside the repo. Test: adversarial-p2.test.ts P2ADV-5 symlinked data dir (spec D21 and the update.sh header). Rationale: cp writes real-work.json and model-guide.json through the link outside the repo, then git add exits 128; preview.sh refuses symlinks under docs/ but update.sh has no such guard.
